question: Forgot username/password, or can't log in to your account

answer.text: Having trouble logging in to your account?
Follow the steps below to recover access. You can always contact us directly for help.
Forgot Email
Use the Forgot Password link to reset the password associated with your email address. Enter each email address you may have used for the account.
If you do not receive any email, please contact us to verify your account and update your email.
Forgot Password
Use the Reset Password link to reset your password with your email address.

items: Enter the email address associated with your account
Check your email for a password reset link

answer.text: No Access to Phone for Verification

items: Full First Name and Last Name
An Invoice Number, Order Number, or other identifier

answer.text: Contact Us

question: Automatically renew an eSIM Data Plan

answer.text: To enable auto-renew, follow these steps:

items: Log in to your ConnectraeSIM account
Go to the Data Plans page
Click Enable Auto Renew or Cancel Auto Renew

answer.text: Auto Renew extends your data plan each month for 30 days. You can toggle this anytime.
Limitations for Long Term Monthly Renewal
Service is for short-term travel (up to 90 days). Renewal beyond 180 days is generally not permitted.

question: Download an invoice for an order

items: Log in to your ConnectraeSIM account
View the Invoice and click Download

question: Add or Remove a Payment Method

items: Log in to your ConnectraeSIM account

answer.text: You can only remove a payment method if there's more than one. At least one method must be active for accounts with services.

question: Change your account email address or phone number

items: Log in to your ConnectraeSIM account
In the top-right menu, go to Profile & Settings
Update your Name, Email, and Phone
